item.title: Ring brings its ‘Search Party’ feature for finding lost dogs to non-Ring camera owners
item.description: Ring's Search Party feature for finding lost dogs is now available across the U.S. — even if you don't own a Ring camera.

item.title: Coalition demands federal Grok ban over nonconsensual sexual content
item.description: Nonprofits urge the U.S. government to suspend Grok in federal agencies after the xAI chatbot generated thousands of nonconsensual sexual images, raising national security and child safety concerns.

item.title: Carbon Robotics built an AI model that detects and identifies plants
item.description: Carbon Robotics' Large Plant Model will allow farmers to kill new types of weeds without having to retrain the machines.

item.title: Linq raises $20M to enable AI assistants to live within messaging apps
item.description: Linq offers an API that lets companies offer their AI assistants via iMessage, RCS and SMS.

item.title: These AI notetaking devices can help you record and transcribe your meetings
item.description: These physical notetakers transcribe audio and give users summaries and action items of meetings using AI. Some even offer live translation.

item.title: AI layoffs or ‘AI-washing’?
item.description: How many of the companies with recent layoffs are just using AI as an excuse?

item.title: Why Tether’s CEO is everywhere right now
item.description: For years, Tether's CEO avoided the United States, watching from offshore as regulators circled and prosecutors investigated. Those days are over.

item.title: Indonesia ‘conditionally’ lifts ban on Grok
item.description: Indonesia has followed Malaysia and the Philippines in lifting a ban on xAI’s chatbot Grok.

item.title: India offers zero taxes through 2047 to lure global AI workloads
item.description: New Delhi's latest move comes as Amazon, Google, and Microsoft expand data center investments in India.

item.title: Bye-bye corporate conglomerates. Hello personal conglomerates.
item.description: Elon Musk's reported merging of SpaceX, xAI, and Tesla harkens back to the heyday of General Electric — or maybe the robber barons of the Gilded Age.

item.title: Nvidia CEO pushes back against report that his company’s $100B OpenAI investment has stalled
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said that a recent report of friction between his company and OpenAI was “nonsense.”

item.title: A peek inside Physical Intelligence, the startup building Silicon Valley’s buzziest robot brains
item.description: If co-founder Lachy Groom has any doubts, he doesn’t show it. He’s working with people who've been working on this problem for decades and who believe the timing is finally right, which is all he needs to know.

item.title: OpenClaw’s AI assistants are now building their own social network
item.description: The viral personal AI assistant formerly known as Clawdbot has a new shell — again. After briefly rebranding as Moltbot, it has now picked OpenClaw as its new name.

item.title: Anthropic brings agentic plug-ins to Cowork
item.description: The company says you can use plug-ins to "tell Claude how you like work done, which tools and data to pull from, how to handle critical workflows, and what slash commands to expose so your team gets more consistent outcomes."

item.title: Last 24 hours to grab your plus-one pass at 50% off to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.description: Today is the last day to lock in a plus-one pass at 50% off to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, happening on October 13-15 in San Francisco.

item.title: Guys, I don’t think Tim Cook knows how to monetize AI
item.description: One intrepid Morgan Stanley analyst dared to ask how Apple will make money on its AI investments. The answer will not shock you.

item.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX, Tesla, and xAI in talks to merge, according to reports
item.description: This merger would bring the Grok chatbot, Starlink satellites, and SpaceX rockets together under one corporation.

item.title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to invest $50B in OpenAI
item.description: If a deal materializes, it would mean Amazon is backing competing startups in the race for AI supremacy.

item.title: Satya Nadella insists people are using Microsoft’s Copilot AI a lot
item.description: With Microsoft spending many billions on data centers, and rumors that no one is using its AI, CEO Satya Nadella shared some usage numbers.

item.title: Apple buys Israeli startup Q.ai as the AI race heats up
item.description: Q.ai is an Israeli startup specializing in imaging and machine learning, particularly technologies that enable devices to interpret whispered speech and enhance audio in noisy environments.
